description: Rules for the LinkedIn profile section. Edit here, not in code. Limits checked October 2026; LinkedIn changes them occasionally — re-check every 6 months (see docs/14-content-guidelines.md).

checks.message: Add a headline. It shows next to your name in every search result and message.
Your headline only repeats your job title. Add what you do and for whom, using words recruiters search for.
Your headline is short. You have up to 220 characters; most strong headlines use 80–160.
Your headline is over LinkedIn's 220-character limit.
Add an About section. It is the one place to explain, in your own words, what you do and what you want next.
Your About section is short. Aim for three short paragraphs: what you do, evidence, what you are looking for.
Your About section is over LinkedIn's 2,600-character limit.
Only the first few lines show before 'see more'. Put the most important sentence first and keep it short.
Your About reads in the third person. LinkedIn profiles usually use 'I' — it sounds more natural.
Your two most recent roles have no description. Add 2–4 lines on what you achieved.
A role description is over LinkedIn's 2,000-character limit.
List at least 5 skills. Recruiters filter searches by skill.
Some phrases are overused on LinkedIn and read as filler. Replace them with something specific.

manual_checklist.text: Set a custom public URL (linkedin.com/in/your-name) and use it on your CV.
Set your location to where you want to work. Recruiters filter by location.

Decide on 'Open to work': recruiters-only is private to recruiters (not guaranteed to hide it from your current employer's recruiters); the public banner is visible to everyone. Both are fine — choose what suits your situation.
Use a clear, recent photo of your face with nothing else in it. We give tips only — we never analyse photos.
Add one or two Featured items that show your work (a project, article or portfolio).
Check which contact details are visible to whom in your Contact info settings.

linkedin_banned_phrases.suggest: Say what you have written or spoken about
Say how many years and in what
Say what you help them do, concretely

keyword_gap.note: Gaps come from skills that appear in at least 20% of recent ads for the user's target role. Under 30 ads, show nothing rather than a weak list.
